item: heistcontrols icon sheet at 48 and 96 pt and in grayscale (icons_48 at c1d14d38)
critique: Icon bodies are near-flat fills under a thick dark outline with sparkle glints; no gloss band, no grain or bevel on the wooden door or skiff hull, little lip. Only the lightning bolt has a real extrusion. (Carried over from c1d14d38: 5f759a03 changes only the two manifests' sources hash; the icon webps are byte-identical.)

item: heistcontrols icon sheet at 48 and 96 pt and in grayscale (icons_48 at c1d14d38)
